name: markupsafe
description: Python module that implements an XML/HTML/XHTML markup-safe string, escaping characters so that untrusted input can safely be displayed in markup. Required by Jinja2.
install: cd markupsafe-3.0.3 && pip3 install --no-index --find-links dist --no-cache-dir --ignore-installed --root="$DESTDIR" --prefix="$PREFIX" MarkupSafe
